summary.title: CTO Framework — Technical Leadership Playbooks & Tools
summary.one_liner: A web knowledge base of playbooks, step-by-step reading routes, and self-assessment tools covering engineering team scaling, architecture standards, and FinOps for technical leaders.
takeaways: The site organises content into three guided routes: people/teams, architecture, and cost/FinOps, each with three numbered steps.
Tools include ADR templates, a 9-box talent grid, a TCO guideline review, and a build-vs-buy decision filter.
A delivery-class assessment uses deployment frequency, lead time, and failure rates to rate your team.
A leadership-style quiz maps decisions to Democratic, Autocratic, or Servant Leadership models.
Gamified scenarios and an AWS system-matching quiz test organisational and infrastructure knowledge.
summary.summary: The CTO Framework homepage presents itself as a searchable knowledge base for CTOs, VPs of Engineering, and technical leaders. It groups content into people and team scaling, architecture, and FinOps, with three-step reading routes linking to specific playbooks and tools. It also offers interactive assessments: a delivery-class check based on deployment frequency, lead time, and failure rates, a leadership-style quiz, a cognitive-bias scenario game, and an AWS matching challenge. The page text is mostly navigation and overview, so detailed method content is not visible here.
